description:
[ISPRA & AIB European electricity emission factor resolver. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates Scope 2 electricity emissions across EU-27 member states using certified ISPRA, EEA, and AIB Residual Mix factors, comparing location-based and market-based accounting with Guarantees of Origin (GOs).
Usage: Use this tool to calculate Scope 2 emissions for CSRD ESRS E1 reporting and ISO 14064 GHG inventories.
Returns: JSON object with { countryIso2: string, accountingMethod: string, consumptionKwh: number, emissionFactorGco2ePerKwh: number, calculatedEmissions: object, esrsE1DisclosureMapping: object }.

accountingMethod.description: GHG Protocol Scope 2 accounting method (default: LOCATION_BASED)

countryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IT, DE, FR, ES, PL)

hasGuaranteesOfOriginGo.description: True if electricity is covered by certified Guarantees of Origin (grants 0 gCO2e/kWh in market-based)

name: ispra_grid_electricity_factor
